query: Consider Kerber's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document allow verbally conveyed information to be considered as Confidential Information?
gold: Information initially furnished orally and identified by the disclosing party as confidential or proprietary at the time of disclosure will be confirmed by the disclosing party as Confidential Information in writing within thirty (30) days.
rag_answer: Yes. Under Kerber’s Non-Disclosure Agreement, information initially furnished orally can be considered Confidential Information, but only if the disclosing party identifies it as confidential or proprietary at the time of disclosure and confirms it in writing as Confidential Information within 30 days.
